text:
Maya: Tiny announcement: I left a cardboard box of leftover holiday cookies in the kitchen  take one, leave one? :) :cookie:
Devon: Omg thank you. Heading there now. Any label about allergens?
Maya: Theres a sticky that says "contains nuts" on the top batch. I separated a gluten-free stack in a smaller tin on the left.
Ravi: Hero-level organization. Also, can we do a micro tradition: take a cookie and write a 1-line holiday micro-kudos on the sticky? Kinda like a mini wall of cheer.
Ellie: Love that. Ill start: "Thanks to infra for saving my deploy last month!" :sparkles:
kudos-bot: New kudos added by Ellie: "Thanks to infra for saving my deploy last month!" :tada:
Devon: I added one for the docs team. This is wholesome.
Maya: If anyone wants to take extra cookies home, feel free. I'll be in the kitchen for the next 20m with hot cider on a tiny burner.
Ravi: Cider + cookies = my holiday productivity boost. :mug:
Ellie: Quick poll: Should we leave the cookies out through Friday or lock them by EOD Thursday? React :one: for Friday, :two: for Thursday.
Devon: Reacted :one: -- leave them for Friday. More chances for stealth cookie snacking.
Maya: OK Friday it is. Also added a little note: "If you take the last cookie, please restock with something equally celebratory if you can!" :party_popper:
Ravi: Signed, sealed, delivered. Happy holidays, short but sweet. Thanks everyone for the cookie cheer!
